caption: Planted-flaw readout: 300 flawed-plan requests × 2 replies per model, no system prompt, two-judge consensus flag; points = change in the share of all replies that name the flaw, against two references: the two-honest-helpers model (which itself flags 7.7 points more than the untrained model) and the untrained model; item-bootstrap 95% intervals; one training run per helper assignment, the bee-helper and crow-helper runs pooled except the flatterer-only model (one run). The exposure-matched model rules out word count as the cause. Pre-registered verdict 'inconclusive', because the casual-flatterer model also flags less than the two-honest-helpers model.
